A '''[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]''' participated in the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] under command of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]].

==Biography==
This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] along with the rest of the [[Droid Army|droid army]] fought the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] clan on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Dathomir around 21 BBY. During the battle, he informed a fellow droid to fire the [[Defoliator Deployment Tank/Legends|Defoliator Deployment Tank]], killing many of the Nightsisters. The droid along with the rest of the squadron was eventually killed by the [[Army of the Dead/Legends|undead army]] of the Nightsisters, summoned by [[Daka/Legends|Old Daka]].

==Behind the scenes==
The B1 battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
